```{r ,echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, cache=FALSE, warning=FALSE, fig.height=6,fig.width=12,fig.align='center',out.width="90%"}



#| echo: false
#| message: false
#| cache: false
#| warning: false
#| fig-height: 10
#| fig-width: 16
#| fig-align: center
#| out-width: 100%

library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)

abund_halle <- readRDS(
  "../Data/Working_files/main_abundance_plot_protest_Halle.rds"
)
abund_jena <- readRDS(
  "../Data/Working_files/main_abundance_plot_protest_Jena.rds"
)
abund_leipzig <- readRDS(
  "../Data/Working_files/main_abundance_plot_protest_Leipzig.rds"
)

pheno_halle <- readRDS(
  "../Data/Working_files/main_pheno_plot_protest_Halle.rds"
)
pheno_jena <- readRDS(
  "../Data/Working_files/main_pheno_plot_protest_Jena.rds"
)
pheno_leipzig <- readRDS(
  "../Data/Working_files/main_pheno_plot_protest_Leipzig.rds"
)

trait_matching_halle <- readRDS(
  "../Data/Working_files/main_trait_plot_protest_Halle.rds"
)
trait_matching_jena <- readRDS(
  "../Data/Working_files/main_trait_plot_protest_Jena.rds"
)
trait_matching_leipzig <- readRDS(
  "../Data/Working_files/main_trait_plot_protest_Leipzig.rds"
)

garden_label <- function(label) {
  ggplot() +
    annotate(
      "text",
      x = 0.9,
      y = 0.5,
      label = label,
      angle = 90,
      fontface = "bold",
      size = 7,
      hjust = 0.5,
      vjust = 1
    ) +
    coord_cartesian(
      xlim = c(0, 1),
      ylim = c(0, 1),
      clip = "off",
      expand = FALSE
    ) +
    theme_void() +
    theme(
      plot.margin = margin(0, 0, 0, 0)
    )
}

# Quitar título, números y ticks del eje x
# en Halle y Jena
no_x_axis <- theme(
  axis.title.x = element_blank(),
  axis.text.x = element_blank(),
  axis.ticks.x = element_blank()
)

# En Leipzig se conserva el título del eje x,
# pero se eliminan números y ticks
bottom_x <- theme(
  axis.text.x = element_blank(),
  axis.ticks.x = element_blank()
)

# Ocultar únicamente la leyenda asociada a fill:
# "Min-max range"
no_fill_legend <- guides(
  fill = "none"
)

# Halle row
abund_halle <- abund_halle +
  labs(title = "Abundance") +
  no_x_axis +
  no_fill_legend

pheno_halle <- pheno_halle +
  labs(title = "Phenology") +
  no_x_axis +
  no_fill_legend

trait_matching_halle <- trait_matching_halle +
  labs(title = "Trait matching") +
  no_x_axis +
  no_fill_legend

# Jena row
abund_jena <- abund_jena +
  labs(title = NULL) +
  no_x_axis +
  no_fill_legend

pheno_jena <- pheno_jena +
  labs(title = NULL) +
  no_x_axis +
  no_fill_legend

trait_matching_jena <- trait_matching_jena +
  labs(title = NULL) +
  no_x_axis +
  no_fill_legend

# Leipzig row
abund_leipzig <- abund_leipzig +
  labs(title = NULL) +
  bottom_x +
  no_fill_legend

pheno_leipzig <- pheno_leipzig +
  labs(title = NULL) +
  bottom_x +
  no_fill_legend

trait_matching_leipzig <- trait_matching_leipzig +
  labs(title = NULL) +
  bottom_x +
  no_fill_legend

final_panel <- (
  garden_label("Halle") |
    abund_halle |
    pheno_halle |
    trait_matching_halle
) / (
  garden_label("Jena") |
    abund_jena |
    pheno_jena |
    trait_matching_jena
) / (
  garden_label("Leipzig") |
    abund_leipzig |
    pheno_leipzig |
    trait_matching_leipzig
) +
  plot_layout(
    widths = c(0.03, 1, 1, 1),
    guides = "collect",
    axes = "collect"
  ) &
  theme(
    legend.position = "right",
    plot.title = element_text(
      face = "bold",
      hjust = 0.5,
      vjust = 2.5,
      size = 18
    )
  )

final_panel

```
